body:
CV page investigation complete. TL;DR: CV is a single self-contained Astro page at src/pages/cv/index.astro (11KB). All content hardcoded in the frontmatter as TS const arrays — no data files. There is NO certifications or education section currently. No images used on the page at all. Only external asset: a downloadable PDF at public/cv/ken-taylor-cv.pdf. Key findings: 1. **Page location**: `src/pages/cv/index.astro` (routes to /cv/). Uses Layout.astro, Breadcrumbs, Navigation, Footer components. 2. **Content structure**: All hardcoded in the .astro file frontmatter as const arrays: - `technicalStack` (line ~32): `{ category: string, items: string[] }[]` - `coreProjects` (line ~57): `{ title: string, description: string }[]` - `experience` (line ~105): `{ role: string, company: string, description: string }[]` - Also static `pageTitle`, `pageDescription`, `jsonLd` (includes schema.org Resume + buildProfilePageSchemas). No JSON/YAML/TS data file exists — `src/data/` dir does not exist. 3. **Certifications/education**: NONE exist. No section, no entries, no mention anywhere in src (grep for educat|certif|school|degree|credential only hits blog posts and landing pages). New section would be added from scratch following existing section pattern. 4. **Section rendering pattern** (repeated 3x): `

Title

{data.map(entry =>
...)}
`. Example snippet for `coreProjects`: ``` {coreProjects.map((project) => (

{project.title}

{project.description}

))} ``` 5. **Images**: No src/assets dir exists. Static images live in `public/images/` (blog/, scangy-logo.webp, sshthing.png, domain-echo-promo3.png). CV page references zero images. PDF at `public/cv/ken-taylor-cv.pdf` linked at line 137 (`href="/cv/ken-taylor-cv.pdf"` with download attr). 6. **Styling conventions**: Tailwind v4 (no config file, CSS-first @theme in src/styles/global.css). Card style = `rounded-xl border border-border bg-surface/50 p-6`; section header = `text-2xl font-bold mb-6`; accent color class `text-accent` for mono labels (`font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-accent`). Suggested next steps (if adding certifications section): - Add a `certifications` const array in frontmatter following existing pattern (e.g. `{ title, issuer, date, link, image? }`), then a new `
` between Experience and CTA mirroring the card markup. - If images needed, either put them in `public/images/` (simple absolute paths) or create `src/assets/` for Astro image optimization (need astro:assets Image import). - Note: blog uses MDX content collections (src/content/blog/) but CV page is plain .astro — no need to touch content config for CV changes.
